title: Unique Games hardness of Max-Cut
statement: Let $\pi/2<\theta<\pi$ and $\delta>0$, and suppose $\theta/\pi+\delta<(1-\cos\theta)/2$. If the Unique Games Conjecture holds, then the promise problem whose yes-instances encode nonempty edge lists with Max-Cut optimum at least $(1-\cos\theta)/2$ and whose no-instances encode nonempty edge lists with optimum less than $\theta/\pi+\delta$ is Promise-NP-hard.
